en: A monochrome drawing of an ornate 19th‑century synagogue on a street corner, surrounded by an iron fence and adjacent buildings, with several small cars, a motorcycle, and pedestrians in the foreground. On the back, printed Hungarian text credits the artist Orsós György and references institutions in Pécs and Bogád, with standard postcard address lines and stamp boxes.
